Cypher: MATCH (b:Business)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(c:Category)<-[:IN_CATEGORY]-(b2:Business) MATCH (r:Review)-[:REVIEWS]->(b2) WITH c, size(split(r.text, ' ')) AS word_count,        CASE WHEN size(split(r.text, ' ')) > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_long_review WITH c, sum(is_long_review) AS long_review_count, count(*) AS total_reviews WITH c, (long_review_count * 1.0 / total_reviews) AS percentage_long_reviews ORDER BY percentage_long_reviews DESC RETURN c.name AS category_name, percentage_long_reviews LIMIT 1

answer: MATCH (b:Business)<-[:REVIEWS]-(review:Review) WITH b, count(review) AS totalReviews MATCH (b)<-[:REVIEWS]-(positiveReview:Review) WHERE positiveReview.stars >= 4 WITH b, totalReviews, count(positiveReview) AS positiveReviewCount RETURN b.name AS businessName, (toFloat(positiveReviewCount) / toFloat(totalReviews) * 100) AS positivePercentage

Question: List the first 3 languages used by streams that have more than 10,000 followers.
Cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE s.followers > 10000 RETURN DISTINCT l.name ORDER BY l.name LIMIT 3

Question: What are the names of the teams that have streams with more than 10,000 followers and have at least one moderator who also moderates a stream with the language "en" and have at least one VIP?
Cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.followers > 10000 MATCH (s)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) MATCH (s)-[:MODERATOR]->(m)<-[:MODERATOR]-(otherStream:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(:Language { name: "en" }) MATCH (s)-[:VIP]->(v) RETURN DISTINCT t.name

Question: What is the total number of streams that have at least one moderator and one VIP who are different users and belong to a team created before 2017 and have more than 50,000 followers?
Cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE (s)-[:MODERATOR]->(:User) AND (s)-[:VIP]->(:User) MATCH (s)-[:MODERATOR]->(m:User), (s)-[:VIP]->(v:User) WHERE m <> v MATCH (s)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WHERE t.createdAt < datetime('2017-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND s.followers > 50000 WITH DISTINCT s RETURN count(s) AS streamCount

Question: Which 3 languages are least common among streams with more than 10,000 followers?
Cypher:

answer: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE s.followers > 10000 WITH l, count(*) as count ORDER BY count LIMIT 3 RETURN l.name as language, count
